title: Miri Scoring Configuration
description: Declares how a linter computes the two scores in a lint report: the additive Conformance score (sum of passing check weights, MUST-gated) and the severity-graded Health score. Draft: reconcile with the reference linter before pinning constraints.

conformance.description: The normative additive model: score = sum of passing check weights (0-100)

must_failure_cap.description: Score ceiling when any MUST check fails (non-conforming); the standard fixes this at 74

grade_bands.description: Lower bound of each grade band

gold_requires_provenance.description: Whether Gold additionally requires PEP 740 attestations (MIRI-PY-005) for public-index wheels

health.description: The normative-baseline severity-graded model over canonical per-check severities

method.description: Named scoring method (e.g. baseline additive-penalty, or a tiered-penalty variant)

profile.description: Frozen, versioned severity profile identifier (e.g. balanced@1)

parameters.description: Method parameters (severity weights, escalation factors, per-severity caps)
